newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FUTURES TRADE TO START IN PORTUGAL'S EDP.
newsitem.headline: FUTURES TRADE TO START IN PORTUGAL'S EDP.

text.p: Portugal's Financial Markets Committee announced on Monday that it had approved the launch of a share futures contract on state-controlled utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal.
It becomes the second single stock on which a futures contract will be based. A futures contract is already traded on Portugal Telecom on the Oporto Derivatives Exchange.
The Derivatives Exchange must set a date for the launch of the new contract.
The Financial Markets Committee set buyer and seller trade commissions at a maximum of 200 escudos, with 500 escudos for the physical exercising of each contract.
It said that the exchange could opt to set lower levels.
